newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila c. bank sets overnight lending at 22 pct.
newsitem.headline: Manila c. bank sets overnight lending at 22 pct.

text.p: The Philippine central bank said on Thursday it dropped its overnight lending rate to 22 percent from 24 percent following the two percentage-point cut in its overnight borrowing rate to 20 percent.
This was the fourth cut in over two weeks since the peso was devalued.
The central bank wants to bring down its rate from a 2-1/2 year high of 32 percent to normalise lending activities.
